premises.text: Home and underground dining phenomena worldwide reflect a lasting need to share food with others
premises.evidence_span: this basic human need to share food with others existed in the past, it exists in the present, and it will continue to exist in the future

premises.text: A community marketplace puts business structure, safety, and trust around authentic dining experiences
premises.evidence_span: simply put business structure, safety, and trust around this phenomena and make it accessible to tens of millions more around the world

premises.text: Verified hosts' events are protected under a $1 million guarantee
premises.evidence_span: all of his events are protected under the Eat With $1 million guarantee

premises.text: Guests book via secure online payment that includes the marketplace commission
premises.evidence_span: make the secure payment online. The payment already includes the itwith commission

premises.text: Demand comes from tourists seeking local authenticity and from locals for social/corporate events

value.text: Diners get authentic local food experiences with interesting people
